correctness.rationale: The radial coordinate x=r²/(1-r²) makes hyperbolic area affine and therefore exactly constant for mean-zero h. Weighted Bergman orthonormal monomials e_n=sqrt((c+1)_n/n!)z^n have disk eigenvalues I_T(n+1,c), with strict gaps lambda0-lambdan=(1-T)^c S_n(T). For fixed bounded h, sufficiently small deformations keep every radius in a compact interval inside the disk; exponentially decaying weighted monomial moments justify trace-norm-analytic perturbation of the isolated simple top eigenvalue. Endpoint differentiation gives the first-derivative coupling c²w_n T^n(1-T)^{2c+2}|hhat_n|² and second diagonal derivative -c(c+1)(1-T)^{c+2}||h||². The Rayleigh–Schrödinger formula yields the exact B_n. The polynomial P_n(T)=w_n S_{n+1}(T)-T w_{n+1}S_n(T) has coefficients with one change from nonnegative to negative and P_n(1)=v_{n+1}>0, hence P_n(T)>0 on (0,1), proving strict spectral order. Independently checked beta integral identities and strict B_n increase for 156 (c,T,n) settings; finite sections do not prove trace-class analyticity.
residual_risks: Only fixed bounded real profiles and small epsilon; no global uniform shape stability or unbounded-profile remainder asserted.
